extracted.name: Baja Sauce for Fish or Shrimp Tacos
extracted.description: This Baja sauce is a creamy topping made with sour cream, mayonnaise, seafood seasoning, cilantro, and ancho chile powder for shrimp and fish tacos.
ingredient_lines: 0.75 teaspoon seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
instruction_lines: Stir together sour cream, mayonnaise, lime juice, cilantro, seafood seasoning, and ancho chile pepper in a bowl.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap; refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.
